split: local spatial triplets: 2 reference / 1 query; fixed across learning seeds
scale: single exp(median_reference(log(r_z15/r_y15))); same factor for both k and all groups/splits
shortcut: distance_z > 2 * source true r15 and abs(theta difference)>pi (A) or distinct branch (B); shared-junction endpoint distances <=0.6 exempt
bridge_neighborhood: source is bridge OR source/target true z kNN15 contains bridge; cross-bridge true edges also evaluated separately
expansion_rule: complete two seed-0 conditions, metrics, figures, report; then extend to seeds1,2 only if 2.0*estimated_remaining_compute + 30min < deadline remaining; no performance-dependent selection
